title: A Silly Wish
lines: Jill has a little pup. His name is Gus.
It was a hot day in the summer sun.
Gus sat by the fish tank and did not move.
He looked at the fish for a long time.
Gus wants to swim just like the fish.
That is a silly wish for a small pup.
Gus jumped up at the tank and slid down.
Jill held the tank so it did not tip.
"You can not swim in there," she told him.
Then Jill filled a dish with cold water.
Gus dipped his nose in and got it wet.
But the dish was much too small for him.
Jill ran to the shed and had a better plan.
She pulled out the big tub from the back.
Mom helped her fill the tub in the sun.
Gus jumped in with a big splash.
His wet fur looked reddish in the bright sun.
Soon the tub was brownish with mud from his paws.
Gus moves his legs and swims a bit.
Now Gus is as happy as a fish.

questions.listenFor: To swim like a fish. Lines three to five say it.

questions.ask: What did Jill try before the tub, and why did it not work?
questions.listenFor: She filled a dish with cold water. The dish was much too small for Gus.

questions.ask: What else could Jill have done for Gus? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any kind answer counts. The story says brownish and reddish, not brown and red — sort of that color. Let them try an -ish word of their own.
